text: 你听见脚下河岸的空洞里传出嗡鸣。你满怀希望，以为找到了其他人，却也警惕这奇怪的声音；你悄悄走到岸边，从稀疏的杜松枝叶间向下窥视。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 502
text: You hear a buzz from a hollow beneath the bank where you stand. Hopeful that you have found others, but wary of the strange sound, you creep to the edge of the bank and peer through a fringe of scraggly junipers.
